india_trends.title: Ola Electric shares surge 16%, biggest 1-day gain since April; why is the stock rallying despite brokerage downgrades?
india_trends.summary: Ola Electric shares jumped 16.3% on October 27, their biggest single-day gain since April, as trading volumes surged and auto-sector sentiment improved. The rebound followed a steep October decline and analyst downgrades, while the stock remains down about 4% for the month.

india_trends.title: Market wrap: Bharti Airtel, Tata Consumer, Asian Paints, Coal India top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
india_trends.summary: Indian equity benchmarks ended nearly flat on Tuesday, with the Nifty 50 slipping 0.02% and the Sensex falling 8 points amid elevated crude prices and caution ahead of the US Fed decision. Tata Consumer and Bharti Airtel led gainers, while Asian Paints and Coal India topped the losers’ list.
